claims.author: ajtowns
claims.harm: removing expiry entirely prevents node operators and miners from reverting to previous default behavior if the change turns out harmful
claims.quote: I don't think it's a good idea to change the node's behaviour in a way that doesn't allow users/miners to revert to the previous default in case the change turns out to be undesirable or harmful for some or many users.

status_by.quote: I think it's nice that we can clean up the code right away. If people can come up with good reasons to use this setting, it might make sense to keep it, or deprecate rather than remove.

claims.status_note: stickies-v argued immediate code cleanup is preferable unless someone provides good reasons to keep the setting

claims.author: ajtowns
claims.quote: Is there any reason why this change shouldn't be phased in via setting `DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS` to a large value, such as 35040 (4 years), instead?
claims.request: phase in the change by setting DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS to a large value (e.g. 4 years) rather than removing it entirely

status_by.quote: If people can come up with good reasons to use this setting, it might make sense to keep it, or deprecate rather than remove. But if we can't, then I think it's sensible to remove it?

claims.status_note: stickies-v answered that cleaning up the code right away is preferable unless concrete use cases exist

claims.author: tumutech
claims.question: whether MallocUsage() should be updated to account for 6 pointers now that entry_time index is removed
claims.quote: would it be fine to use 6 in MallocUsage() so that the same -maxmempool budget can hold extra txn you talked about in the nice side-effect?
